_help: Copy to ~/.config/wealth-ledger/personal.json (chmod 600) and replace every value with your own. Keys starting with _ are comments.

networth._help: Balance-sheet tab labels (column A, exact). synced: label -> account_name LIKE patterns (as shown in v_accounts) whose live balance replaces the sheet value.

credit_limits._help: Card credit limits for cards whose feed reports none (Plaid sends its own; SimpleFIN never does): account_name LIKE pattern (as shown in v_accounts) -> limit in dollars. Takes effect on the next sync.

home.cad_note: appraisal-district market value as of Jan 1

odometer: where the odometer reading came from
cars.sanity: optional note, e.g. a dealer trade-in estimate

crypto._help: exchange_rows: wallets that have their own balance-sheet row (only coins the crypto total counts are counted there).

dashboard._help: exact: networth.py line label -> category; rules: [regex, category] fallbacks tried in order. Categories: cash retirement taxable crypto metals realestate vehicles other.

budget._help: insights/budget.py: [transaction regex on 'payee | description', budget-line regex on 'category/item' of the 'income sheet' tab]; tried before the generic defaults in budget.py. Put your landlord, utilities and people you pay here.

amazon._help: insights/amazon.py: [item regex on 'department | product name', budget-line regex on 'category/item' of the 'income sheet' tab] for Amazon order items; tried before the generic ITEM_RULES. Put rules for your own hobbies, properties or brands here.

inherited_ira._help: insights/inherited_ira.py (dashboard 'Inherited IRA'). account: v_accounts name LIKE pattern (default: BDA/INHERITED/BENEFICIARY). Facts: death_year of the original owner, owner_started_rmds true/false (null = unknown), your beneficiary_birth_year, optional owner_birth_year, growth_rate for the plan, optional year_end_balances {"YYYY": balance} when no Dec 31 snapshot exists.

networth_history._help: insights/nw_history.py (dashboard trend before the daily snapshots): Drive name of your yearly balance-sheet spreadsheets, each named '<name_query> YYYY' with a 'balance sheet' tab (dated columns, a 'Total Equity' row).

zelle_memos._help: insights/zelle_memos.py: Gmail search for your bank's Zelle emails (default: zelle)

backup._help: bin/wealth-ledger-backup (run after each daily sync): gzipped copy of the database into dir, which should be on a different disk and must already exist. Keeps keep_days of dailies plus every 1st-of-month copy. Leave out to turn backups off.

simplefin_watch._help: bin/simplefin-institution-check: search SimpleFIN's institution list for these queries; ignore maps a query to the exact result that is already known.
simplefin_watch.label: the account you are waiting for
